title: Pocketwire Business Profile Sales Limits by Tier
content:
Two sales limits apply to every Pocketwire Business Profile: a rolling 7-day sales limit and a maximum amount for one sale, both in US dollars. The rolling 7-day window is the handling date and the six preceding calendar days, Eastern Time. Column headings abbreviate the six tiers of the Pocketwire Business Profile: Pocketwire Business Starter, Pocketwire Business Essentials, Pocketwire Business Growth, Pocketwire Business Pro, Pocketwire Business Premier and Pocketwire Business Enterprise.

| | Starter | Essentials | Growth | Pro | Premier | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rolling 7-day sales limit | USD 10000.00 | USD 25000.00 | USD 50000.00 | USD 150000.00 | USD 300000.00 | USD 1000000.00 |
| Maximum single sale | USD 2500.00 | USD 5000.00 | USD 10000.00 | USD 25000.00 | USD 50000.00 | USD 100000.00 |

## What each limit governs

| Limit | Crossed when | Consequence recorded against the limit |
|---|---|---|
| Maximum single sale | one payment is above the figure | the payment is declined to the buyer and not booked |
| Rolling 7-day sales limit | a sale takes the rolling 7-day sales above the figure | the sale is accepted; the part above the limit is held and a review starts |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- On Pocketwire Business Essentials, a single payment of USD 5000.00 is not above the USD 5000.00 maximum; a payment of USD 5000.01 is.
- On Pocketwire Business Starter, with USD 9200.00 of sales already in the 7-day window, a further sale of USD 1000.00 takes the window to USD 10200.00, which is USD 200.00 above the USD 10000.00 limit.
